info.name: ClearDue guarded PayPal sandbox capability
info.description: Synthetic project resources only. Configure private sandbox environment; writes are disabled. Never export configured credentials. Prefer pnpm test:paypal for domain/approval-pipeline verification. This collection is manual capability assistance, not proof that any operation ran.

exec: if (!url.startsWith('https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com/')) throw new Error('Sandbox host only');
if (pm.environment.get('sandbox_test_enabled') !== 'true' || pm.environment.get('sandbox_write_enabled') !== 'true') throw new Error('Explicit sandbox test/write flags required');

if (url.includes('/invoices/')) { const id = pm.environment.get('invoice_id'); const own = (pm.environment.get('project_invoice_ids') || '').split(',').map(s => s.trim()); if (!id || !own.includes(id)) throw new Error('Allowlist this project-created invoice ID first'); }

if (pm.request.method === 'PUT' || url.endsWith('/send')) { const seen = JSON.parse(pm.environment.get('observed_invoice_json') || 'null'); if (!seen || seen.id !== pm.environment.get('invoice_id') || seen.detail.memo !== 'ClearDue project-created synthetic sandbox capability test' || Date.now() - Number(pm.environment.get('observed_at')) > 30000) throw new Error('Read this tagged project invoice immediately before writing'); }

if (pm.request.method === 'PUT') { if (pm.environment.get('approved_correction') !== 'true' || !pm.environment.get('approved_invoice_put_json')) throw new Error('Review a complete approved writable payload first'); JSON.parse(pm.environment.get('approved_invoice_put_json')); }
pm.test('Created', () => pm.expect([200,201]).to.include(pm.response.code)); // Inspect privately and explicitly allowlist the returned invoice ID. Do not auto-repeat after timeout.

item.name: 3. Read authoritative invoice and hosted recipient link

exec: pm.test('Read invoice', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200)); pm.test('GBP invoice', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail.currency_code).to.eql('GBP')); if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.environment.set('observed_invoice_json', JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())); pm.environment.set('observed_at', String(Date.now())); } // Inspect paid/due/transactions; PAID event/name alone is insufficient.

item.name: 4. Send tagged synthetic draft (guarded, no update email)

exec: pm.test('Update acknowledged', () => pm.expect([200,204]).to.include(pm.response.code)); // Always read back and verify all preserved fields. Unknown outcome means reconcile, never blind retry.
